# DeepSeek Harness

Version: @deepseek-ai/dsh 0.2.1-rc.5, tag dsh-v0.2.1-rc.5 (b830ec950faba0a46dda564be3e2d854afed94f1). Collected on Windows x64, 2026-11-03.

The home-level patch list the official Web runtime loaded, connecting the lab's echo MCP server, written as YAML in JSON form as the lab wrote it; a second row inserting a source inspector is left out, and paths are normalized. No Fastctx row is present. dsh applies this list to every profile; an MCP server is a row inserting its MCP client plugin.

Upstream: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness
